purpose: Supplemental diagrams for the repository redesign handoff. Conceptual and source-based scopes remain explicit.
font: System sans-serif stack. No external font dependency.

integration.accessibility: Preserve role, title, desc, and prefixed IDs when inlining.
integration.responsive: Put case diagrams in a local overflow-x:auto wrapper. Use a min-width of 640px, or 720px for verification-paths. The homepage map can scale freely.
integration.scope: Conceptual diagrams do not claim a particular deployed system. The two source-backed abstractions remain bounded to the inspected personal modules.
integration.source_credit: Design method adapts cathrynlavery/diagram-design. Project-specific labels use the completed source review.

diagrams.caption: Separate what the system suggests, what may act, and what actually happens.
The adapter translates the request. The external service performs its own operation.
Each pass updates the record. Reuse includes a fresh check.
Solid path: the work. Dashed paths: what the record retains.
